identitySignals: Official website baypeace.org is titled 'BAY-PEACE: BETTER ALTERNATIVES FOR YOUTH', matching the agenda name, and gives an Oakland, CA address matching the agenda location
A public listing (inplay.org) shows a BAY-Peace ECCCO Summer Internship in Oakland that asks for a current ECCCO OUSD student, matching the agenda's ECCCO Student Internship Program MOU
Website describes youth leadership, internship and community organizing programs, consistent with OUSD's Linked Learning workplace training partner MOU
research.notes: BAY-Peace is a fiscally sponsored project of Social Good Fund, so it has no EIN or legal entity of its own; the sponsor's EIN was intentionally not used. General email on the site is obfuscated, so omitted. OUSD link seen on inplay.org ECCCO Summer Internship listing (not cited).

profile.summary: BAY-Peace: Better Alternatives for Youth is an Oakland youth leadership program started in 2007. It offers education, arts, community organizing and healing programs for Bay Area young people affected by militarism and systemic violence. It is a fiscally sponsored project of Social Good Fund.
